entries.text: Dataset 'CPCB City Air Quality Index (24 Sep 2026)' (Environment): CPCB National Air Quality Index for 245 Indian cities on 24 Sep 2026 (24-hour average, 4 PM bulletin): AQI value, category, prominent pollutant and monitoring stations. Cities matched to LGD districts where unambiguous. Keywords: AQI,air quality,pollution,CPCB,city,district,environment
entries.dataset_title: CPCB City Air Quality Index (24 Sep 2026)

entries.text: Dataset 'NASA POWER District Daily Weather 2025' (Climate): Daily rainfall, maximum/minimum air temperature and relative humidity for every Indian district in 2025, from NASA POWER (MERRA-2 based) at each district's point-on-surface. Point values on a ~0.5-degree grid, not district area averages. Keywords: rainfall,temperature,humidity,NASA,POWER,daily,district,climate,2025

Dataset 'Open-Meteo ERA5 Daily Weather 2025 (Pilot Districts)' (Climate): Daily rainfall, maximum/minimum air temperature and mean relative humidity in 2025 for 22 pilot districts, from the Open-Meteo historical weather API (ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis) at each district's point-on-surface. Keywords: rainfall,temperature,humidity,ERA5,reanalysis,Open-Meteo,daily,district,climate,2025

Dataset 'Grid-India State Daily Power Supply Position (Sep 2026)' (Energy): State-wise daily electricity Power Supply Position for September 2026 from Grid-India (NLDC) daily reports: peak demand met, shortage at peak, energy met, drawal schedule, over/under-drawal and energy shortage. State level only; rows for utilities (Railways, DVC, BALCO...) have no state. Keywords: electricity,power,demand,energy met,shortage,state,daily,energy,Grid-India
entries.dataset_title: Grid-India State Daily Power Supply Position (Sep 2026)

entries.text: Dataset 'NFHS-5 District Health Indicators (2019-21)' (Health): National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) district fact-sheet indicators for 706 districts: 104 indicators on population, nutrition, anaemia, maternal and child health, and non-communicable disease risk, with the NFHS-4 (2015-16) value alongside. One row per district x indicator. Keywords: NFHS,health,nutrition,anaemia,stunting,immunization,district,survey

Dataset 'District-wise Crop Production' (Climate): Kharif-season crop production (tonnes) for 12 Indian districts, with each district's annual precipitation (cm) and average temperature (°F). One row per district x crop. Keywords: crop,production,agriculture,kharif,precipitation,temperature,district
